latestAction.text: Resolution agreed to in Senate without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S3024)

summary.text: This resolution designates June 23, 2026, as Social Media Harms Victim Remembrance Day and encourages government, industry, and community stakeholders to take action to prevent social media-related harm.

title: A resolution designating June 23, 2026, as "Social Media Harms Victim Remembrance Day".
